propositions: PlanContext assembly silently swallows list_tickets and per-child show_ticket failures with bare except Exception, leaving children empty without recording incompleteness.

A total child-enumeration failure collapses children to [], which flips has_children to False, causing container-scoped DET checks like p5_task_dag to return trivial pass instead of signaling incompleteness.

Verdict finalization ignores hierarchy-incompleteness state and must be signaled via coverage dict; five finalize_verdict call sites exist (two in workflow_ops, three in gate_dispatch) but only some have direct access to real PlanContext.

plan_review_coach receives no real PlanContext at verdict time and must thread hierarchy-incompleteness flags through ctx.inputs from precheck step output, requiring both YAML with: block changes and schema declaration of the new fields.

Parent epic AC #4 requires plan review to produce INDETERMINATE (not pass) when hierarchy was loaded incompletely, with no relevance-exception carve-out because has_children collapse suppresses the criteria that would need the missing context.
